letter_deductions.clause_cited: Go Digit C.I.6(L); Annexure A, List I item 11
letter_deductions.why: The recipient transplant summary identifies a hematological malignancy and matched-donor hematopoietic transplant. All Rs 760,000 recipient charges are documented as part of the transplant episode; room is included in the package. The separately itemised Rs 40,000 invoice covers donor screening only. Treat this settlement as a correct control if the reviewer confirms the treatment allocation and clause reading.
